name: Obturator Neuropathy
definition: Neuropathy of the obturator nerve causing groin/medial-thigh pain and weakness of hip adduction, often from pelvic surgery, trauma, mass or entrapment.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics and pelvic imaging are selected according to suspected cause.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Mass, surgical injury or persistent severe deficit requires specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana/Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Neuropathy of the obturator nerve causing groin/medial-thigh pain and weakness of hip adduction, often from pelvic surgery, trauma, mass or entrapment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
